title: Engineering Department UT Chandigarh Recruitment 2026 – Junior Engineer Posts
shortInfo: Engineering Department UT Chandigarh has announced notification for Junior Engineer posts. Required qualification: Diploma. Last date to apply: 08-10-26.
howToApply: Eligible and willing officers should apply in the prescribed format (Annexure-I).
Applications must be forwarded through proper channel to the Chief Engineer, Engineering Department, UT, Chandigarh.
Applications must be accompanied by photocopies of ACRs/APARs for the last five years duly attested.

A certificate (Annexure-II) must be enclosed confirming that the particulars furnished are correct, no disciplinary/vigilance case is pending or contemplated, and the official will be relieved upon selection.
Supporting certificates/documents in support of qualification and experience claimed must be enclosed.
Incomplete applications or applications not accompanied by ACRs/APARs for the last five years will not be entertained.
Applications must reach on or before 30 days (Latest by 08.10.2026) from the date of publishing the Public Notice on the website.
Candidates who apply on deputation basis will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently.

Closing Date for Online Registration & Submission of Online Applications

howToApply: Visit PGIMER’s official website at www.pgimer.edu.in and click on the Recruitment link at the Home Page.

Complete Online Registration by filling mandatory details: Advertisement No., Advertisement Date, Name of Applicant (as per matriculation certificate), Date of Birth (as per matriculation certificate), Mobile No. & Email ID.
After successful registration, an acknowledgement will be sent to the registered Email ID with User ID and Password.
Login using the credentials received and click on ‘Go to Application Form’.
Fill the application form section-wise: personal information, qualifications, experience, and upload required documents/certificates.
Upload scanned passport-size coloured photograph (JPEG, 50-80 KB, taken on or after 01.07.2026) with name and date indicated on the photo.

Upload legible scanned copies of all required documents: educational qualifications (from Matric onwards), mark sheets, date of birth certificate, category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/PwBD), experience certificates, NOC from present employer (if employed), etc.
Pay the application fee online through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking (avoid UPI) via the application portal’s payment gateway.
After payment, the application is considered complete. Take a printout of the submitted application form.

Candidates in employment must also forward their application through proper channel to the Administrative Officer, Recruitment Cell of the Institute within 10 days after the last date for submission of online application.

title: AAI NR Recruitment 2026 – Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, ITI Trade Apprentice Posts
shortInfo: AAI NR has announced notification for Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, ITI Trade Apprentice posts. Required qualification: Degree, Diploma, ITI. Last date to apply: 16-09-26.
howToApply: Visit BOAT’s/RDAT’s web portal: www.nats.education.gov.in (for Graduate/Diploma Apprentices) or www.apprenticeshipindia.org (for ITI Trade Apprentices).
Register yourself on the concerned portal (NATS/NAPS) prior to applying for apprenticeship training in AAI.
Find establishment: Airports Authority of India – RHQ NR, New Delhi (NDLSWC000002(BOAT) / E05200700101(NAPS)) and click on the Apply button.
Complete your profile with all required details including educational qualifications, communication details, and training preferences.
Upload required documents including qualifying degree/provisional certificate in PDF format.
After successful application, the portal will display the message: ‘Successfully applied for the training position. Based on availability, you will be contacted by the establishment.’
Candidates applying for more than one discipline will not be considered and their application will be rejected.
No Application Fee is being charged.

title: NHM Dhamtari Recruitment 2026 – Laboratory Technician, Staff Nurse, Medical Officer, ANM & Other (walk-in) Posts
shortInfo: NHM Dhamtari has announced notification for Laboratory Technician, Staff Nurse, Medical Officer, ANM & Other (walk-in) posts. Required qualification: BHMS, BAMS, 12TH, B.Sc, BUMS, BMLT, ANM, GNM, M.Sc, 10TH, BPT, M.A, DMLT. Last date to apply: 31-08-26.
howToApply: Candidates must appear for walk-in interview on the scheduled date and time at the District Health Office (CMHO Office), Dhamtari.
Report at the venue between 09:00 AM and the specified time for document verification and registration.
Bring all original documents along with self-attested photocopies for verification.
Details and schedule are available on the official website: www.dhamtari.gov.in
No separate call letter will be issued; this notification serves as the interview call.
Candidates must fill the application form available at the venue or downloadable from the official website.
